870914.rationale: No country has acknowledged deploying its own orbital weapons as of June 24, 2026. US Space Command's Whiting (Apr 2026) said Russia is fielding Nivelir co-orbital ASATs, but that is an accusation, not a self-acknowledgment. US space-based interceptors are planned for a 2028 demo, and France's patrol and 'action' satellites (Toutatis, laser/jammer payloads) for 2027. The US is the most plausible self-acknowledger, but the null outcome is most likely, so total mass is kept low.
870914.next_info: AFA Air, Space & Cyber conference (mid/late Sept 2026); Golden Dome/SBI updates; Space Force posture statements; any Putin/MoD space-weapon announcements. Resolution window runs to Dec 31, 2026.
